lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a later same day decision e g a project wide tooling adr supersedes an earlier decision s implementation mechanics text update the earlier decision s own status text in state md to point at the newer one do not leave the conflict to be silently reconciled only via a code level spec deviation comment discovered later by a future feature

lessons.key: gate_fail::before wiring an existing local gate script into an automated ci workflow first run that exact script clean end to end against the current default branch a pre existing exit code failure a human verifier already knows to read past e g a machine owned file s formatting nit will make every single ci run fail identically since ci has no equivalent judgment to distinguish accepted baseline noise from a real regression
lessons.text: Before wiring an existing local gate script into an automated CI workflow, first run that exact script clean end-to-end against the current default branch — a pre-existing exit-code failure a human Verifier already knows to read past (e.g. a machine-owned file's formatting nit) will make every single CI run fail identically, since CI has no equivalent judgment to distinguish accepted baseline noise from a real regression.
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml / c2e3468 (pnpm biome check . exits 1 deterministically on the current tree due to the unaddressed pre-existing .specs/lessons.json formatting baseline) (ci-cd/gate-check)
